3845-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3845-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

262-3881-7515.easyPrerequisites:
Blistercoil Weird doesn't have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery is attached to Blistercoil Weird.
262-3881-7515.description:
Activate Blistercoil Weird using the ability granted to it by Elemental Mastery by tapping it, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the token(s) enter, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {W}.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost by paying {W}, targeting any valid target(s).
Blistercoil Weird triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping it.
Resolve Scrollboost, giving up to two creatures +2/+2 each until end of turn.
Repeat.

728-1400-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1400-4619.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5468-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5468-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-5468-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

372-1090-3647.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-3647.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

1895-4399-4770-7399.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4017-6752-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-6752-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
3259-4885-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3678-5478-6681-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
There's another land on the battlefield.
3678-5478-6681-6879.description:
Play Strip Mine.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Strip Mine.
Activate Strip Mine's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting another land.
Haru triggers, returning Strip Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.
3678-5478-6681-6879.notes:
You can use this combo as a lock, destroying any lands you wish as they enter. To do this combo infinitely, simply target the same land each loop while keeping the Strip Mine abilities on the stack.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2457-3129-4289-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2342-4668-7070.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
2342-4668-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat.

1486-2494-3459-7223.description:
Activate Dwarven Bloodboiler by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the Dwarven Bloodboiler ability, giving target creature +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1274-2034-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2173-3652-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1580-4050-5632.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4120-4968-6774.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-6774.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-6774.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2178-2921-3362-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-2921-3362-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

654-880-6517.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-6517.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Repeat.

719-1409-2972-6348.easyPrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with Sarkhan.
"Dragon" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1409-2972-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it, Ganax and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, choosing Ganax and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3490-5231-5870-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-5231-5870-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Guide of Souls indestructible.
3490-5231-5870-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2034-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

222-413-527-1849.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-1849.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2239-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Ardent Elementalist
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Ardent Elementalist
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2724-3987-5163.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Roon of the Hidden Realm. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2871-3199-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2871-3199-5195.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 4.

2-198-1651-3526.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
2-198-1651-3526.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Etherium Spinner triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Thopter and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1110-1339-3802.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give The Locust God indestructible.
You have a way to draw a card.
1110-1339-3802.description:
Give The Locust God indestructible by any method.
Draw a card by any method.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Illusory Ambusher.
Illusory Ambusher triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

539-2050-4684.notablePrerequisites: Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
539-2050-4684.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping itself.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.
